lesson: A daily Donchian trend system chosen on 2021-23 lost on 2024-25; 20-50% a month is not realistic.
Funding carry made money only when funding was high; in 2026 it took no trades.
Indicator systems that win big in development (mostly SOL 2021) fail on later data.
One coin (AVAX) carried a +183% holdout; returns spread over few coins are luck, not edge.
Every scalp (1m-1h) lost after fees, even with 55% wins; 4h EMA pullback was weakly positive at 1-2% risk.

Fast take-profits raise the win rate but lose money; 4h continuation patterns with a 2R target were small but positive on unseen coins with very few trades. x20 leverage cut BTC/ETH trades because liquidation sits about 5% away.

lesson: Trading more often (5-10+ a week) made every method worse after fees. The video's London breakout, Heikin-Ashi scalp and zone break all lost on 5m crypto bars; W1 rules on 1h (about 20 trades a week on three coins) lost 72% on untouched TRX at 1% risk. Williams volatility breakout (T2) was the only frequent method positive in development (+24% at 2%), untested on fresh data.
Check that every test coin has a leverage-bracket table before a final; TRX lacked one and its first final runs took zero trades (voided and rerun).
